errors.not_enough_space: Not enough free disk space: this needs {needed_gb} GB in {folder}, and {free_gb} GB is free.
errors.off_grid: The raster written to {path} is not on the project grid; nothing was recorded.
errors.raw_not_as_asked: The download {path} is not the 2-band Int32 raster in {crs} that was asked for; nothing was recorded.
errors.mask_not_as_asked: The mask download {path} is not the 1-band 0/1 raster in {crs} that was asked for; nothing was recorded.
errors.no_aoi_or_grid: The project needs an AOI and a grid before anything is downloaded.
errors.source_native_unknown: {source}: its native grid (projection and scale) is unknown; edit the source.
errors.bands_not_loaded: {source}: its band list is not loaded from Earth Engine yet; try again in a moment.
errors.not_a_source: {source} is not a source of this project.
errors.not_ready: {source} is not downloaded and harmonized for this period; run Download & harmonize first.
errors.footprint_missing: The footprint of the earlier set {set_id} is missing; run Integrate & vectorize on that set again first.
errors.no_sources: Choose at least one source, each once.
errors.no_drawing: The drawn-area mode needs a drawn polygon.
errors.attribute_band_missing: The attribute raster has no band {band} (it has {bands}).
errors.attribute_no_crs: The attribute raster {path} has no coordinate reference system.
errors.no_tippecanoe: tippecanoe was found neither next to Python nor on the PATH.
errors.project_not_a_manifest: {path} is not a project manifest of this app.
errors.project_newer_schema: {path} has schema {found}; this app reads schema {expected}.
errors.no_images: Download the before and after images first.
errors.folder_not_writable: The folder {folder} is not writable: the layer's overviews cannot be written next to it.
errors.ee_asset_not_found: The Earth Engine asset {asset} does not exist, or your account cannot read it.
errors.download_busy: Another Earth Engine download was still running after {minutes} minutes, so {file} was not downloaded. Run this step again once it finishes.
